name: game-hint
description: The hint line under the prompt adds what to press now: ESC 후퇴 while working, /compact 휴식 at low HP, 오류부터 읽기 after repeated failures, /save 세이브 when a save is due

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: off adds nothing; casual adds one or two hints; hardcore also counts the failures

lowHp.title: Low HP (%)
lowHp.description: Suggest /compact when context left drops to this percent

saveEvery.title: Save every (turns)
saveEvery.description: Suggest /save after this many turns without one (needs game-save-point)
